subject: [hw] DEC04 final dec04.patch hash (2fa3b974): comment wording only; suite still 2043/2043
body:

  sha256 vcu/test_dec04/dec04.patch  2fa3b9741dfc373b8ac4999debaa1f953f9ca80fa6d5bca33996d66b56e0919b  (14423 bytes)

dec04-v40-adapt.patch is unchanged (8580d5f7...). The comment now says "A combined full-word store does not read the register first" instead of the ambiguous "A full-word store no longer reads...". Nothing else to review beyond the merged-read hunk: vcu_wc_flush_read() sends [queued stores..., READ] in one batch when a guest read arrives with stores queued (only when combining is ON).
